scope: Exploratory frozen-artifact retrieval sensitivity and supplemental reporting; no counterfactual SQL accuracy
randomization: deterministic Random primary-review:graph-key:seed; reassign existing IDs without replacement
limitations: Input shuffling preserves IDs; randomized IDs affect lexical ties, graph lookup limits and final packing together.
Method-label swapping rehashes full raw facts before evidence attachment; held-ID control is also checked.
Larger context caps do not remove seed/lookup limits. Retrieval coverage does not predict unrun planner outcomes.
Identifier visibility is a lexical/normalization diagnostic, not proof of semantic support or necessity.
Refusal categories are manual-reviewable text heuristics checked against each saved SQL; frozen failure labels stay unchanged.
